annotations.title: Add cases to my Pro Workspace

description: Signed-in Pro or Firm attorneys only. Puts up to 25 of the attorney's cases into THEIR OWN Comp Desk Pro Workspace as finished tabs with the built-in calculator tiles (SLU, LWEC, CCP, Section 32, Burns, apportionment) filled in. Send inputs only, as facts taken from the WCB decisions and the file (claimant label, WCB number, hearing date, date of accident, the AWW found, each tile's inputs); the workspace computes every rate, award, fee and net itself. Statutory rates and results are refused by name, as is any field that does not map onto a tile. Re-sending the same case (same WCB number and hearing date) never makes a second tab. Call describe_case_schema first; afterwards get_import_status returns the figures the workspace computed.
name: add_workspace_cases
